meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Hermes adaptation with minimal notes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件持久化任务计划与进度，避免上下文丢失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在AI对话中管理多步骤任务并防止进度丢失
copy.tagline_en: Persist task plans and progress in files to survive context loss
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage multi-step tasks in AI conversations and prevent progress loss

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在项目目录中创建并维护三个 Markdown 文件（task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md），用于持久化记录任务计划、发现和进度，即使对话被清除也能恢复工作。
howto.when: 当用户要求规划、分解或组织一个多步骤项目、研究任务或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个多步骤项目，创建任务计划文件。
记录我刚才发现的关键信息到 findings.md。
say.note: Claude 会将发现写入 findings.md 文件。

say.text: 更新进度，标记第一阶段完成。
say.note: Claude 会更新 progress.md 中的状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates and maintains three Markdown files (task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md) in the project directory to persistently record task plans, discoveries, and progress, allowing work to survive context loss and /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls.

say_en.text: Help me plan a multi-step project and create task plan files.
say_en.note: Claude will create task_plan.md and start tracking.

say_en.text: Log the key findings I just discovered into findings.md.
say_en.note: Claude will write findings to findings.md.

say_en.text: Update progress, mark phase 1 as complete.
